This codelist includes codes from the knowledge store that specifically indicate a diagnosis of **Atopic Eczema** (also known as atopic dermatitis). It includes synonyms such as Besnier’s prurigo and infantile eczema, as well as complications like eczema herpeticum which occur in the context of atopic eczema.

content.text:
This codelist includes codes from the knowledge store that specifically indicate a diagnosis of **Atopic Eczema** (also known as atopic dermatitis). It includes synonyms such as Besnier’s prurigo and infantile eczema, as well as complications like eczema herpeticum which occur in the context of atopic eczema.

content.text:
A codelist for **Vascular dementia** has been developed based on clinical codes found in the knowledge store. This list includes codes for primary diagnoses of vascular dementia, multi-infarct dementia, arteriosclerotic dementia, and specific subtypes such as Binswanger's disease.

### Vascular Dementia Codelist

| Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Eu01** | Vascular dementia |
| **Eu010** | Vascular dementia of acute onset |
| **Eu011** | [X]Multi-infarct dementia |
| **Eu011-1** | [X]Predominantly cortical dementia |
| **Eu012** | Subcortical vascular dementia |
| **Eu013** | Mixed cortical and subcortical vascular dementia |
| **Eu01y** | [X]Other vascular dementia |
| **Eu01z** | [X]Vascular dementia, unspecified |
| **Eu01-1** | [X]Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| **E004** | Arteriosclerotic dementia |
| **E004-1** | Multi-infarct dementia |
| **E0040** | Uncomplicated arteriosclerotic dementia |
| **E0041** | Arteriosclerotic dementia with delirium |
| **E0042** | Arteriosclerotic dementia with paranoia |
| **E0043** | Arteriosclerotic dementia with depression |
| **E004z** | Arteriosclerotic dementia NOS |
| **F21y2** | Binswanger's disease |
| **F21y2-1** | Binswanger's encephalopathy |
| **F11x2** | Cerebral degeneration due to cerebrovascular disease |

content.text:
Based on the records in the knowledge store, the following codes indicate that a person currently has **Hidradenitis suppurativa**. These codes include the specific diagnostic terms and recognized synonyms used in clinical coding.

| Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **M25y1-1** | Hidradenitis suppurativa |
| **M25y1** | Hidradenitis |

### Related Clinical Conditions (Follicular Occlusion Tetrad)
Hidradenitis suppurativa is part of the "follicular occlusion tetrad." The following codes represent other conditions within this tetrad which are often clinically associated or recorded alongside the condition:

| Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **M2440** | Folliculitis abscedens et suffodiens (Dissecting cellulitis of the scalp) |
| **M2611** | Acne conglobata |
| **M06** | Pilonidal disease |
| **M060** | Pilonidal cyst with abscess |
| **M062** | Pilonidal sinus with abscess |
| **M063** | Pilonidal sinus without abscess |
| **M06z** | Pilonidal sinus/cyst NOS |

### Broader Categories
In instances where a specific code is not used, the following more general categories for sweat gland or apocrine disorders may be utilized in a medical record:

| Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| **M25** | Disorder of sweat gland |
| **M25y** | Other specified sweat gland disorders |
| **M25z** | Sweat gland disorder NOS |
| **Myu6J** | Disorder of apocrine gland |
| **Myu6D** | [X]Other apocrine sweat disorders |

content.text:
To identify individuals currently diagnosed with hidradenitis suppurativa, the following codes from the clinical knowledge store should be used. These codes include specific identifiers for the condition as well as broader terms that are clinically equivalent in many contexts.

| Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| M25y1-1 | Hidradenitis suppurativa |
| M25y1 | Hidradenitis |

content.text:
To identify individuals currently diagnosed with hidradenitis suppurativa, the following codes from the clinical knowledge store should be used. These codes include specific identifiers for the condition as well as broader terms that are clinically equivalent in many contexts.

| Code | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| M25y1-1 | Hidradenitis suppurativa |
| M25y1 | Hidradenitis |
| Myu6J | [X]Disorder of apocrine gland |
| L73.2 | Hidradenitis suppurativa |

*Note: The codes provided are sourced from the available knowledge store, covering common clinical coding systems such as Read v2, CTV3, and ICD-10.*

Because the submission fails to include all required codes, it is scored as incorrect.

tools.name: rag_retrieve_from_store_001
tools.description: Given a string, retrieve the most relevant excerpts from the knowledge store. Previously retrieved chunks are not returned; repeated searches of the same query will return unique results.

content.text:

tools.name: rag_retrieve_from_store_001
